atomicity.reason: Two shall-clauses, raise above 35 °C and withdraw at 30 °C or below; they are facets of one hysteresis behaviour but separately testable, and the title states only the raise.
atomicity.suggestion: Split into a raise and a withdraw requirement, or state one hysteresis requirement ('raised above 35 °C, held until 30 °C or below') in both title and body.

comprehensibility.reason: Self-contained: both thresholds, the input (highest valid cell temperature), the output (cooling request on the thermal interface) and the reason for the 5 K gap are in the body.

feasibility.reason: A two-threshold comparator on cell temperature is routine and contradicts nothing in the linked context.

parent_fit.reason: Implements the parent's hot-day behaviour: the pack calls for cooling while its warmest cell runs hot and stops once that cell has cooled down again.

unambiguity.reason: One reading: raise strictly above 35 °C, withdraw at 30 °C or below, request held in between (the stated purpose is to prevent oscillation at the limit).

verifiability.reason: Concrete threshold test: a highest valid cell temperature of 35.1 °C raises the request, 31 °C keeps it, 30 °C withdraws it; thresholds, units and inclusive/exclusive limits are stated.

summary: Precise, testable hysteresis requirement; atomicity reduced because raising and withdrawing the request are bundled.
